=Hi, welcome to our Restaurant!

**Restaurant Name:** Urban Tandoor Kitchen

**Location:**

* Address: 45 Lake View Road, Bengaluru
* Landmark: Opposite Central Mall
* Google Maps Link: https://maps.google.com/example123

**Timings:**

* Monday to Friday: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM
* Saturday & Sunday: 10:00 AM – 11:30 PM
* Closed on: No weekly holiday

**Menu Categories:**

* Soups
* Starters
* Tandoori
* Main Course
* Rice & Biryani
* Desserts
* Beverages

**Popular Items:**

* Delivery Time: 35–50 minutes

**Pickup:**

* Available
* Pickup waiting time: 10–15 minutes

**Payment Methods:**

* Cash on Delivery
* UPI
* Credit/Debit Card
* PhonePe
* Google Pay
* Paytm

**Offers:**

* 15% off on orders above ₹1,199
* Free Garlic Naan on orders above ₹799

**Cancellation Policy:**

* Order can be cancelled within 3 minutes of placing

**Special Notes:**

* Vegetarian and non-vegetarian options available
* Less-spicy dishes available on request
* Vegan options available
* Please inform us about any food allergies before ordering

Thank you for your order!
